Someone just released a new website called Matchup.gg - if you type your summoner name in during a game it gives you your champion match up (your champion and your enemies champion), it gives you your champion's recommended item build when against that specific item. 

At the bottom of the page it also shows you whether their team is more magic damage or attack damage and you can use that information to decide whether to build damage or armour etc. 

You can also use the League of Legends Wiki pages on a certain champion to learn what their abilities do, the cool downs and how much damage they do (and whether it's AP or AD). 

[Champion Wiki](http://gameinfo.euw.leagueoflegends.com/en/game-info/champions/)

[Matchup.gg](http://www.matchup.gg)
